hypothesis: The prior NLL-only isolation left the candidate residual-off action expert 0.72451% worse than a same-budget trained Base. Route action-expert gradients exclusively from a matched current-student residual-off flow forward; route residual-on flow, Gaussian NLL, and regularizers exclusively to ZeVA parameters.
gradient_clipping: Action expert and ZeVA adapter are clipped separately at norm 1.0, so ZeVA gradients cannot rescale the Base-matched action-expert update.
other_training_settings: Frozen VLM, Stage1 ZTE/Mamba, causal bank and task retrieval; H50 output/H15 execution; ten tasks; seed1000; TorchCodec and torch.compile. The ordinary Base control uses the same starting Base004500, optimizer-step budget and data contract.
pretraining_tests: actual-PI fixed-batch residual-off versus standard Base action-expert gradient equivalence
decision: Fixed step1000 must have residual-on H15 error lower than its own residual-off and the same-budget trained Base1000 on identical validation samples/noise. Reject this route otherwise; even a positive offline result is not closed-loop success. Only a passing candidate is sent to the normal paired 10-task rollout without changing seeds or labels.
caveat: The most recent completed formal Base/ZeVA success rates remain 55%/55%, and the declared 57% Base reference condition remains unmet.
